texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员回收了[From.GetName]附近的反射性多面体，并将其带回船上仔细研究。该物体的最有趣的特性就是可以反射大多数向其发射的低频能源波束。高频能源波束则不受影响，使该物体的特性无法用于舰队防御。

尽管对其进行了详尽的调查，[Root.GetName]科研团队仍旧无法判明这个奇特多面体的功能，或是来源。它似乎是空心的，但其类金属表面雕刻着某种科学符号。尽管无法获知该编码数据的完整意义，令人困惑的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]相信它与虫洞度量学有关。

通过研究这些科学符号，我们的科研团队在虫洞理论方面取得了令人兴奋的进展。但这个物体的确切用途仍是个谜。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew has recovered the reflective polygonal object near [From.GetName], bringing it onboard for detailed study. The object's most intriguing quality is its ability to reflect most types of low-frequency energy beams directed toward it. High-frequency energy beams, however, remain unaffected, making the object's properties useless with regards to any potential fleet defense applications.

Despite extensive examination, the [Root.GetName] research team has been unable to determine the function, or origin, of this peculiar polygon. It appears to be hollow, but its metalloid surface is engraved with some kind of scientific notation. Though the full meaning of this codified data eludes us, [Root.GetLeaderName] believes it relates to wormhole metrics.

Our research team was able to glean some fascinating insights into wormhole theory by studying these notations. Whatever purpose this object was created for, however, is still a mystery.

summary.text:
# 无法扫描的物体 / Unscannable Object

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:922-942; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:10103 (distar.270)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。小行星可能生成（1级，权重1，每个帝国一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on asteroids (level 1, weight 1, once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.270“深奥的多面体”：回收的多面体能反射低频能量束，表面刻有似与虫洞度量有关的科学记号，用途与来源仍是谜。奖励物理学研究，记录标本 sonic_reflective_prism。若帝国正在进行“L星团”事件链（l_cluster_chain，需《遥远繁星》），结果增加一条线索（共需7条）；集齐时触发 distar.10904“L星门见解汇集”（另一故事）。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.270 "Puzzling Polygon": the recovered polygon reflects low-frequency energy beams and is engraved with notation that seems to concern wormhole metrics; its purpose and origin remain unknown. Rewards physics research; specimen sonic_reflective_prism. If the empire is running the L-Cluster event chain (l_cluster_chain, Distant Stars), the result adds one clue (7 needed); completing the count fires distar.10904 "L-Gate Insights Gathered" (a separate story). The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

排外帝国只看到“令人不安”选项，效果相同。

Xenophobes only see "Disconcerting"; same effects.
